title: Runtime repair: independent adversary
summary: No in-regime fire for two-active-leaf repair. Source-history proof must use prescribed cut shapes; tree formalization and global runtime theorem remain open.

claims.label: Two-active-leaf geometric repair
claims.detail: Finite fresh implementation found no counterexample. Independent ordinary proof attempt retained; not a formal tree theorem.

claims.label: Arbitrary simultaneous-cut history strengthening
claims.detail: Protected b=(x,y) can be erased by simultaneous cuts of x,y. This is outside source branch rules and does not refute source history.

lemmas.label: Conditional scaled affine implication
lemmas.detail: Lean kernel checked positive-denominator coefficient arithmetic, scaled integer affine implication, height inequalities, and budget drop. A deliberately false arithmetic control failed.

lemmas.label: Source cut-shape preservation
lemmas.detail: Ordinary exhaustive-case attempt for singleton, pendant-path, and BCY sets; no formal structural theorem and no held-out author verification.
